description: This PHP source file defines the SystemCheckPluginConfiguration class, which implements configuration interfaces for a plugin within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to initialize the plugin and register CLI commands related to system checks.

classes.name: SystemCheckPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Implements plugin and console configuration interfaces for the system check plugin, providing methods to initialize the plugin and register CLI commands.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given HTTP request. Currently, the method has no implementation.

methods.name: registerCommands
methods.description: Registers console commands, specifically the ToggleSystemCheckScreenCommand, with the provided console object.
